channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Rutland Town Select Board unanimously agreed to support the Walmart supercenter project. They will speak at the December first Act two fifty hearing about economic impacts. Walmart plans to move from downtown Rutland City to the former Diamond Run Mall site.

Vermont’s Legislature has a record number of new lawmakers this session. Fifty-six new representatives and seven new senators will face a steep learning curve. Early progress may be slow as they tackle affordability and education reform.

North Country Ministry expanded emergency assistance into southern Essex County towns like Schroon Lake and Ticonderoga. Funded by a one hundred fifty thousand dollar grant, it helps families with fuel, housing, and utilities. Caseworkers travel to food pantries to reduce transportation barriers for residents.

Fourteen Vermont construction professionals graduated from the first Associated General Contractors Leadership Academy. The program combined classroom learning with hands-on field work in leadership and safety. Graduates are prepared to lead and develop their crews effectively.
